rows.answer_text: Visakoivu Oy holds a valid F-kaasuasetuksen mukainen patevyys, valid until 2028-01-31, covering the refrigeration and air conditioning work included in this contract's scope.
Visakoivu Oy holds a valid Urakkavarmenne Varmennettu Toimittaja certificate, valid until 2026-12-31, and it will remain valid at the time this tender is submitted.

Fire protection systems (alarm panels, detectors, extinguishers and, where installed, sprinkler systems) are maintained on a scheduled inspection and testing cycle in line with statutory intervals, with any defects logged, reported and scheduled for correction; specialist servicing of sprinkler and suppression systems is coordinated with an authorised fire safety equipment provider where this falls outside Visakoivu Oy's own trades.

Corrective maintenance requests are logged and prioritised by severity, with routine faults attended within an agreed working-day window and higher-priority faults attended sooner; specific response and completion time targets by category will be set out in the SLA schedule agreed with Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy at contract start.

Visakoivu Oy operates a 24/7 on-call arrangement for emergency situations affecting food production or cold storage continuity, staffed by qualified technicians who can be reached by phone at any time; emergency calls receive an immediate telephone response, with on-site attendance targets for safety- and production-critical faults set out in the SLA schedule agreed with the client.

Environmental management arrangements during the work follow Visakoivu Oy's NMSB 74210:2015 environmental management system, covering refrigerant handling and recovery in line with F-gas regulation, waste segregation, and minimising disruption to ongoing food production operations.

Visakoivu Oy will take handover of the existing asset register and associated documentation at the start of the contract, verifying it against the property list in Appendix 2, and will maintain it as a live document within our NMSB 7310:2015 quality management system, updated after each maintenance visit.

The quoted price is broken down by cost category: scheduled maintenance labour, materials and consumables, refrigerant and F-gas-related costs, subcontracted specialist work (e.g. fire safety servicing), and any time-and-materials rate for corrective work outside the scheduled scope.
Visakoivu Oy proposes payment terms of 30 days net from the date of a correctly issued invoice.

Visakoivu Oy encloses CVs of the key personnel proposed for this contract, drawn from our teams of 62 LVI technicians and 48 electricians, with staff assigned to refrigeration and F-gas work holding the qualification cited in Section 3.1.
Pricing in this tender is quoted in EUR per square metre per year, as required, and not as a monthly rate.
This quotation is submitted as a single PDF file, without password protection, in accordance with Section 6.3.
This quotation document uses a minimum font size of 11 pt throughout, as required.
This tender is submitted by e-mail to hankinta@myllyrantaelintarvike.example ahead of the deadline of 20 March 2026, 12:00 Helsinki time.

Visakoivu Oy reports to the client monthly, summarising completed scheduled and corrective work, outstanding items and their status, and any recommendations arising from inspections, with an immediate written report for any safety-critical finding as soon as it is identified.

Lift maintenance is not a discipline in which Visakoivu Oy itself holds a statutory servicing qualification. Visakoivu Oy will engage an authorised lift maintenance subcontractor holding the certification required under Finnish lift safety regulation for any lift maintenance element of this contract, managed as part of Visakoivu Oy's overall maintenance contract with Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy.

Visakoivu Oy operates an environmental management system certified to NMSB 74210:2015, covering waste sorting, refrigerant and chemical handling in line with F-gas regulation, and monitoring of environmental aspects across our maintenance operations; a description of the system is attached to this tender as required by Annex A.3.

general_sections.cover_letter: Visakoivu Oy is pleased to submit this quotation for technical maintenance services for Myllyranta Elintarvike Oy's food production and cold storage facilities in the Jyvaskyla region. We are experienced in maintaining refrigeration, HVAC and electrical systems for operationally sensitive environments and would welcome the opportunity to support the continued technical management of these facilities.
general_sections.company_overview: Visakoivu Oy is a technical and property services company based in Jyvaskyla, offering HVAC, electrical, building automation and facilities maintenance to public and private clients across Central Finland, including food production, cold storage and other operationally demanding facilities.
